digests.text: Week in local AI: 156 models captured, 15 new preserved mirrors. Now downloadable: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct, academic-ds-9B, Seed-OSS-36B-Base, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp….

This week aiarchive.info captured 168 open-weight model repos and mirrored 15, with no alerts or radar signals. Captured families include Qwen (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-Embedding, Qwen-Image), DeepSeek (V3.2, V4-Flash, OCR), Tencent Hunyuan, Xiaomi MiMo, MiniMax, and Wan video models. Mirrored copies now include Baichuan-M3-235B, Yi-6B/34B, Seed-OSS-36B, Qwen3-8B, and DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp.

This week aiarchive.info captured 162 open-weight model repos, including new entries from Qwen (Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3-ASR-1.7B), DeepSeek (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-OCR-2, DeepSeek-Math-V2), and MiniMax (MiniMax-M3, MiniMax-M3-MXFP8, MiniMax-H3). 15 repos were mirrored, among them Baichuan-M3-235B, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and several Yi and Seed-OSS checkpoints. No alerts or radar signals were recorded this week.

This week aiarchive.info captured 152 open-weight model repos and mirrored 15 of them for long-term preservation. New captures span major Chinese labs including Qwen (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-Embedding, Qwen-Image), DeepSeek (V3.2, V4-Flash, DeepSeek-OCR), Tencent Hunyuan, MiniMax, Moonshot Kimi, and zai-org GLM, alongside international releases from OpenAI, Meta, Mistral, and Google. Mirrored copies include Baichuan-M3-235B, Yi-6B/34B variants, Seed-OSS-36B, and DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, ensuring these weights remain downloadable independent of their original hosts.

This week aiarchive.info captured 170 open-weight model repos and mirrored 15, including new Baichuan, ByteDance-Seed, Qwen, and DeepSeek entries. Newly captured families span Qwen (Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen-Image 2.1), DeepSeek (V4-Flash, V3.2-Speciale, OCR-2), MiniMax (M2.5 through M3), and Tencent (Hunyuan, Hy-MT2, WeVisDoc). No alerts were triggered; radar signals included HN front-page posts on Qwen Image 2.1 and small local models such as Cactus Needle 3.

This week the archive captured 24 open-weight model releases, including tencent's Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B in FP8, GGUF, and Interleave variants, plus inclusionAI's Ling-3.0-flash and Ling-3.0-tiny-UBTree. openbmb added GPTQ and int4 builds of MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and internlm released Atria-Dawn with an FP8 version.
